name: Hero Payoff Companion
description: A generic or rights-cleared host visibly connected to one separate tangible result object.
composition_guidance: Place one generic or rights-cleared host on one side and one separate tangible result object on the other. Use contact, gaze, or posture to make their relationship clear. Reserve one upper title band for the complete intended episode title rendered directly by the selected image model. The active Visual Style remains the final authority for medium, palette, texture, lighting, and rendering technique.
composition_rules: Use one generic or rights-cleared host and one separate tangible result object.
Connect host and object through contact, gaze, or posture.
Give both the host and payoff object a clear role in the reading order.
Reserve one clean upper title band.
required_elements: A visible contact, gaze, or posture connection
One upper title band with the model-rendered complete episode title
avoid_elements: A lone object without a host
Branded products, creator likenesses, or exaggerated outcomes
Copied trade dress, logos, watermarks, or post-render typography compositing
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended episode title directly in the upper title band. Use one, two, or three balanced lines according to title length while preserving the host-object relationship.
visual_style_guidance: The recipe controls the generic host, separate tangible payoff object, their connection, and the title band. The active Visual Style remains authoritative for all rendering choices.
